title: Create remote protocol identities
responsibility: Define protocol encodings and derive identifiers, challenges and request or credential hashes.

inputs.name: remoteIdentity.publicKey
inputs.description: 65-byte uncompressed P-256 public point as bytes or unpadded base64url.

inputs.name: credentialHash.binding
inputs.description: Host or device role, host ID, optional device ID and credential text to bind together.

inputs.name: pkceChallenge.verifier
inputs.description: PKCE verifier text to hash with the S256 transform.

inputs.name: randomId.bytes
inputs.description: Number of random bytes to encode; defaults to 16.

inputs.name: normalizeCode.value
inputs.description: Human-entered code to uppercase and strip of nonalphanumeric characters.

inputs.name: requestDigest.request
inputs.description: Wire request whose method and deterministically serialized input identify its operation.

outputs.name: remotePatterns
outputs.description: Regular expressions describing protocol IDs, public keys, credentials, codes and other encoded wire values.

outputs.name: remoteIdentity
outputs.description: First 40 lowercase hex characters of the public-key SHA-256 digest.

outputs.name: credentialHash
outputs.description: SHA-256 hex digest bound to role, host, device and credential using a protocol-specific prefix.

outputs.name: pkceChallenge
outputs.description: Unpadded base64url SHA-256 digest of the UTF-8 verifier.

outputs.name: randomId
outputs.description: Random lowercase hexadecimal identifier with two characters per requested byte.

outputs.name: randomCredential
outputs.description: 43-character base64url credential generated from 32 random bytes.

outputs.name: pairingCode
outputs.description: Random pairing code displayed as two groups of four characters separated by a hyphen.

outputs.name: normalizeCode
outputs.description: Uppercase alphanumeric code with punctuation and other characters removed.

outputs.name: requestDigest
outputs.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the method and stable input JSON; excludes the request ID.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects malformed public-key encodings or a point without the required 65-byte uncompressed shape; byte, hash and serialization failures may propagate.
